slides.0.title: VDP — The Top Estate Association
slides.1.title: 🦅 What Is VDP?
slides.1.content: VDP (Verband Deutscher Prädikatsweingüter) was founded in 1910 and is the most influential quality organisation in German wine. It currently has around 200 leading estate members, identified by its emblem: an eagle with spread wings paired with a grape motif. VDP has built its own four-tier classification, modelled on Burgundy's Grand Cru concept, ranking sites by vineyard character and historical reputation — complementing the gaps in the official QmP system.

slides.5.title: Quick Quiz
slides.5.questions.0.question: Dry white wines from VDP Grosse Lage are commonly called?
slides.5.questions.0.explanation: A dry white wine from a VDP Grosse Lage (grand cru vineyard) is called Grosses Gewächs (GG) — the German equivalent of a French Grand Cru, and the pinnacle of dry German white wine.
slides.5.questions.1.question: In 'vdp-classification', the correct order of the VDP pyramid (low to high) is?
slides.5.questions.1.explanation: The VDP pyramid runs, from base to apex: Gutswein (estate wine) → Ortswein (village wine) → Erste Lage (premier vineyard) → Grosse Lage (grand cru vineyard). The structure mirrors Burgundy's Village/Premier Cru/Grand Cru pyramid, advancing from overall estate style to single grand cru sites step by step.
